summary: Tested EpiRent Crewbrain deep fetch integration (Personal chapter sub-items). Backend: 9/9 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All features working - crew data from Personal chapters displayed on job cards with progress bars, EpiRent badges, and correct styling.
critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/orders/epirent/{order_pk}/crew correctly fetches crew from Personal chapter sub-items via _ref_chapter_items URLs
POST /api/orders/epirent/crew/batch correctly handles multiple orders with semaphore(3) concurrency
Crew data cached in MongoDB crew_cache for 30 minutes
Frontend correctly displays EpiRent crew data with count, title, and time range
Green background (bg-green-50, border-green-400) applied when fully staffed
Orange border (border-orange-200) applied when partially staffed
Progress bars show assigned/needed ratio with correct colors
EpiRent badge displayed on cards with crew data from EpiRent
'+ Personal definieren' button shown for orders without crew data
seed_data_creation: No new seed data - used existing EpiRent orders
context_for_next_testing_agent: EpiRent Crewbrain deep fetch tested. Key orders: PK=92 (Gartenmarkt Neuwied 2026 I Strom) has 4 crew items from Personal chapter (2x Elektrotechniker + 1x Helfer on 09.04, 2x Elektrotechniker + 3x Helfer on 12.04). PK=93 (Gartenmarkt Neuwied 2026 I Sicherheit) has 1 crew item (1x Elektrotechniker). PK=11 (NLS 3) has no personal chapter. Batch endpoint at POST /api/orders/epirent/crew/batch uses semaphore(3) for concurrency and caches in crew_cache collection for 30 minutes. Frontend at /einsatzplanung shows job cards with EpiRent crew data (badge, count, title, time), green background when fully staffed, orange border when partially staffed.
